title: Extensions Container
description: Container for domain-specific extensions using reserved namespaces. Each project or domain gets its own namespace. Adding new top-level namespaces requires a MINOR schema version bump. Follows the pattern established by signalJourney's extension system.

signalJourney.description: Namespace for signalJourney processing pipeline metadata.

nemar.description: Namespace for NEMAR-specific properties (API fields, legacy fields).

dataQuality.description: Namespace for data quality metrics and indicators.

rawDetail.description: Namespace for detailed per-channel arrays (channel names, types, TSV data). Separated from core to keep core documents lean.

dataCite.description: Namespace for DataCite DOI registration metadata (publisher, resource type, geo_locations, alternate_identifiers, related_items). Note: keywords, related_identifiers, contributors, dates, rights, and language moved to core in v0.3.0.

dataCategories.description: Namespace for study classification (paradigm, clinical context, cognitive domains).

x-extension-managers.description: Maps each extension namespace to its owning service and MongoDB collection. Core fields are platform-neutral; extension collections have separate access control per service.
